candidates.source_name: 1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) / Book of the Watchers (1 Enoch 1-36)
candidates.draft_body:
1 Enoch (Ethiopian tradition) Book of the Watchers (1 Enoch 1-36) (c. 200 BC)

'And these are the names of the holy angels who watch' — the foundational seven-archangel list: Uriel (chief of the host of the firmament + chief of paradise + chief of the cherubim), Raphael (chief of the spirits of men), Raguel (over the world of the luminaries), Michael (chief of Israel + over chaos), Saraqael (the spirits of the children of men who transgress), Gabriel (over paradise + serpents + cherubim), Remiel (over those who rise from the dead). The Tewahedo Synaxarium honors all seven on dedicated days; the seven-archangel framework is one of the most explicit Tewahedo angelological inheritances from the Mäṣḥafä Hēnok, with Catholic and Orthodox traditions partially preserving the framework but Protestant traditions almost entirely losing it.
